Maya D.: opened PR #5280 to add a short PSK-based local KMS example for sealed/private installs + an HSM post-rotation sanity checklist. Also found a broken cert anchor in the certs page. Need quick reviews and a tiny Node + Python snippet for airgapped fallbacks.

Docs Bot: link-checker: PR #5280 -> 1 broken anchor -> /docs/private/certs#psk (404). Recommended replacement: /docs/private/certs#preshared-key.

Ethan L.: I'll add the Node snippet and a curl test. Draft Node example: ```js
// NodeJS minimal PSK fallback (env recommended)
process.env.RW_KMS = 'psk'
process.env.RW_KMS_PSK = 'base64:REPLACE_ME'
const rwinf = require('rwinf-sdk')
const client = new rwinf.Client()
// client will use RW_KMS & RW_KMS_PSK from env
``` Quick curl check (local KMS): `curl -H "X-RW-PSK: base64:REPLACE_ME" -k https://127.0.0.1:8443/healthz`

Nina V.: Security note: never commit PSKs. Prefer env vars, KMS-backed secrets, or a mounted file with strict perms. Add filesystem perms example: `sudo chown redwood:redwood /etc/redwood/psk && sudo chmod 640 /etc/redwood/psk`.

Jordan K.: Rollback appendix: include this sequence and blockers. Example commands: `rwinfctl rollback --to v2026.05 --force` (may revert DB migrations), then before starting run `rwinf-admin cache flush --prefix=model:` to avoid stale metadata. For graceful restart use systemd pattern: `sudo systemctl stop redwood-inference && tar -xzf /opt/redwood/releases/v2026.05.tgz -C /opt/redwood && sudo systemctl start redwood-inference` and call out expected ~45-90s outage while caches warm.

Maya D.: Also want a tiny Python snippet that falls back from PSK to file-based local KMS when PSK probe fails (for airgapped sites). Draft: ```python
import os
from rwinf_sdk import Client, KMSUnavailable

os.environ.setdefault('RW_KMS','psk')
os.environ.setdefault('RW_KMS_PSK','base64:REPLACE_ME')
client = Client()
try:
    client.kms.ping()
except KMSUnavailable:
    os.environ['RW_KMS'] = 'local'
    os.environ['RW_KMS_PATH'] = '/var/lib/local-kms/keys'
    client = Client()
``` Add note: run in non-prod first.

Ethan L.: I'll fix the cert anchor to `/docs/private/certs#preshared-key`, add both snippets, and push. Adding @Nina V. for the HSM checklist review. :thumbsup: 

Docs Bot: automated-checks: please ensure all inline commands use backticks and fenced blocks use triple backticks. CI & link-checker will re-run on push.

Nina V.: HSM post-rotation checklist to add: list slots `pkcs11-tool --list-slots --module /usr/lib/hsm/libhsm.so`, confirm token label matches `/etc/redwood/hsm.conf`, re-run `pkcs11-tool --login --slot <id>` to validate PINs, and export slot mapping: `pkcs11-tool --list-slots > /tmp/hsm-slots-$(date +%s).txt`. Call out device node perms if using a hardware HSM.

Maya D.: Perfect. I'll merge after link-checker is green and Nina confirms the HSM mapping smoke-test in staging. :shipit:
